summary: 30-ft L-4 tower dated 1944, Montana DNRC land east of Missoula; two listings say gone, a travel guide says a hike goes up to it. Unresolved.

facts.status_note: Two lookout listings say gone; a travel guide says you can hike up to the tower. Not resolved.

access.note: Clearwater State Forest is open year-round. Any recreational activity on state trust land, hiking included, needs a Recreational Use License, per the travel guide.

visit.trail_note: A travel guide lists a hike up to the Hunter Point Lookout Tower. The two lookout listings do not agree.

notes_for_editor: Status conflict is unresolved. firelookout.com and the FFLA list say Gone. Discoveringmontana.com (an undated travel page) says you can hike up to the Hunter Point Lookout Tower. Before publishing Gone as settled, check with Montana DNRC or a dated visitor report. The Montana list at montanalookouts.weebly.com spells it Hunters Point and lists it under Montana DNRC, 14N-14W-30. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403. mapcarta and getamap are OpenStreetMap-derived and were not used. No photo URLs were found. Search and read budget was used in full.
